# Data import

Setup:

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycollo)
library(data.tree)
library(combinat)
library(here)

source(here("src", "utils", "measures.R"))
```

We don't need to change `comboDF`, fortunately! So let's just import it.

```{r}
comboList = readRDS(here("output", "01_extract_pairs", "comboList.rds"))
```

# Getting a DF of combinations

From comboList, we will now get the get the DF rows. The function `expand_grid()` allows us to get combinations of the SFP/adverb whenever there is more than one of either.

```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(glue)

getSameTypeRowsFromCombos = function(combos, type = "dc"){
  n = length(combos[[type]])
  if(n == 0){
    result = data.frame(matrix(c(NA, NA), nrow = 1))
    colnames(result) = paste0(type, "_", c(1,2))
  } else if(n == 1){
    result = data.frame(matrix(c(combos[[type]][1],NA,NA,combos[[type]][1]), byrow=T, nrow = 2))
    colnames(result) = paste0(type, "_", c(1,2))
  } else {
    result = data.frame(t(combn(combos[[type]], 2)))
    colnames(result) = paste0(type, "_", c(1,2))
    result = result %>%
      add_row("{type}_1" := NA,
              "{type}_2" := combos[[type]][1],
              .before = 1)%>%
      add_row("{type}_1" := combos[[type]][n],
              "{type}_2" := NA)
  }
    mutate(result,
           docID = combos$docID,
           paragraphID = combos$paragraphID,
           sentenceID = combos$sentenceID,
           sentence = combos$sentence)
}

combosDFs_dc = lapply(comboList, getSameTypeRowsFromCombos)
combosDF_dc = bind_rows(combosDFs_dc)
rm(combosDFs_dc)

combosDFs_sfp = lapply(comboList, getSameTypeRowsFromCombos, type = "sfp")
combosDF_sfp = bind_rows(combosDFs_sfp)
rm(combosDFs_sfp)
```

# Getting consolidated adverbs and final particles

We'll calculated measures and apply our two filters:

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(glue)
getMeasuresDFFiltered = function(combosDF, slot_1 = "sfp", slot_2 = "dc"){
  measures = getMeasures(combosDF, c(slot_1, slot_2), c(slot_1, slot_2), doc_id = "docID")
  measures_df = measures$results
  by = getBenjaminiYekutieli(measures_df$p_fisher_yates_attract)
  measures_df = measures_df %>%
    mutate(p_fisher_yates_reject = by$reject)
  if(interactive()) View(measures_df)
  measures_df %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[slot_1]]), !is.na(.data[[slot_2]]), p_fisher_yates_reject, DP_norm < .99)
}

selectedDF_dc = getMeasuresDFFiltered(combosDF_dc, "dc_1", "dc_2")
selectedDF_sfp = getMeasuresDFFiltered(combosDF_sfp, "sfp_1", "sfp_2")
```

Having consolidated them, we can now modify the original `combosDF`.

First, though, let's get the rows of the old `combosDF` that contain the extracted combos:

```{r}

selectedDF_dc = selectedDF_dc %>% mutate(combo = paste0(dc_1, dc_2))
selectedDF_sfp = selectedDF_sfp %>% mutate(combo = paste0(sfp_1, sfp_2))

extractedComboTypes_dc = selectedDF_dc %>%
  filter(!is.na(dc_1), !is.na(dc_2)) %>%
  pull(combo)
extractedComboTypes_sfp = selectedDF_sfp %>%
  filter(!is.na(sfp_1), !is.na(sfp_2)) %>%
  pull(combo)

combosDF_dc = combosDF_dc %>%
  mutate(combo = paste0(dc_1, dc_2)) %>%
  mutate(comboExtracted = combo %in% extractedComboTypes_dc)
combosDF_sfp = combosDF_sfp %>%
  mutate(combo = paste0(sfp_1, sfp_2)) %>%
  mutate(comboExtracted = combo %in% extractedComboTypes_sfp)
```

# Replacing original combosDF lines with collated adv/dc

```{r}
comboListNew = comboList
for(entry in 1:length(comboListNew)){
  if(length(comboListNew[[entry]]$dc) > 1){
    combos = combn(comboListNew[[entry]]$dc, 2) %>% as.matrix
    combosString = combos %>%
      apply(2, function(x) paste0(x, collapse = ""))
    combosAreCollo = combosString %>%
      sapply(function(x) x %in% extractedComboTypes_dc)
    comboListNew[[entry]]$dc = comboListNew[[entry]]$dc %>%
      setdiff(combos[,combosAreCollo] %>% as.vector %>% unique) %>%
      c(combosString[combosAreCollo])
  }
  if(length(comboListNew[[entry]]$sfp) > 1){
    combos = combn(comboListNew[[entry]]$sfp, 2) %>% as.matrix
    combosString = combos %>%
      apply(2, function(x) paste0(x, collapse = ""))
    combosAreCollo = combosString %>%
      sapply(function(x) x %in% extractedComboTypes_sfp)
    comboListNew[[entry]]$sfp = comboListNew[[entry]]$sfp %>%
      setdiff(combos[,combosAreCollo] %>% as.vector %>% unique) %>%
      c(combosString[combosAreCollo])
  }
}
```

Now we can do the comboDF again:

```{r}
getRowsFromCombos = function(combos){
  n_sfp = length(combos$sfp)
  n_dc = length(combos$dc)
  if(n_sfp == 0) combos$sfp = NA
  if(n_dc == 0) combos$dc = NA
  expand_grid(sfp = combos$sfp, dc = combos$dc) %>%
    mutate(docID = combos$docID,
           paragraphID = combos$paragraphID,
           sentenceID = combos$sentenceID,
           sentence = combos$sentence)
}

combosDF = lapply(comboListNew, getRowsFromCombos) %>% bind_rows
```

# Getting final results

```{r}
selectedDF_exp2 = getMeasuresDFFiltered(combosDF, "dc", "sfp")
selectedDF_exp2 = selectedDF_exp2 %>% filter(!is.na(dc), !is.na(sfp))
```

# Exploring the results

```{r}
selectedDF_exp1 = read_csv(here("output", "02_measures", "exp1_selected_df.csv"))

selectedDF_exp1_exp2_comparison = selectedDF_exp2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(dc), !is.na(sfp)) %>%
  select(dc, sfp, n, pmi) %>%
  full_join(selectedDF_exp1,
            by = c("dc", "sfp"),
            suffix = c("_exp2", "_exp1"))
```

# Saving the results

```{r}
write_excel_csv(selectedDF_dc %>% filter(!is.na(dc_1), !is.na(dc_2)) %>% select(dc_1, dc_2, n, pmi),
                here("output", "03_precollation", "exp2_collated_dc.csv"))
write_excel_csv(selectedDF_sfp %>% filter(!is.na(sfp_1), !is.na(sfp_2)) %>% select(sfp_1, sfp_2, n, pmi),
                here("output", "03_precollation", "exp2_collated_sfp.csv"))
write_excel_csv(selectedDF_exp2 %>% select(dc, sfp, n, pmi, kld_norm_dc_cond_sfp, kld_norm_sfp_cond_dc),
                here("output", "03_precollation", "exp2_selected_df.csv"))
write_excel_csv(selectedDF_exp1_exp2_comparison,
                here("output", "03_precollation", "exp1_exp2_comparison.csv"))
# per-sentence adverbs / particles after collation, for the site's example sentences
saveRDS(comboListNew, here("output", "03_precollation", "comboListNew.rds"))
```
